title: NeSySpec: Neuro-Symbolic Technical Intelligence for Auditing Engineering Specifications with an Application to Aircraft
abstract: arXiv:2610.35403v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Engineers who audit a declared specification of an engineered system need to know which physical constraints it respects, which it violates, which field was altered and how to correct it. NeSySpec is an integrated and interpretable neuro-symbolic audit framework, built on Logic Tensor Networks, that answers these questions in one pipeline. Its axioms encode the physical relations of the domain as differentiable graded predicates whose tolerances are learned from a fleet of real records; from the same degrees, it diagnoses the violated constraint, identifies the altered field by abduction, proposes a minimum-change correction and ties image evidence to the parts it describes, abstaining exactly where evidence is missing, and returns all of it in one verification report. We validate NeSySpec on 107 aircraft types, with 16 test aircraft of 9 families held out of training, on specification records paired with ground photographs and satellite

translated_title: NeSySpec：用于工程规格审计的神经-符号技术智能——以飞机为应用案例
translated_abstract: 审计工程系统所声明规格的工程师需要知道该规格满足哪些物理约束、违反了哪些约束、哪个字段被篡改了以及如何修正它。NeSySpec 是一个集成且可解释的神经-符号审计框架，构建于逻辑张量网络之上，可在单一流水线中回答这些问题。其公理将领域的物理关系编码为可微分的分级谓词，其容差从真实机队记录中学习得到；基于这些隶属度，它能诊断被违反的约束、通过溯因推理识别被篡改的字段、提出最小变更的修正方案，并将图像证据与其所描述的部件关联起来，在证据缺失时精确弃权，并将所有结果汇总在一份验证报告中。我们在107种飞机型号上验证了 NeSySpec，其中来自9个机系的16架测试飞机未参与训练，使用与地面照片和卫星图像配对的规格记录进行验证。
tldr: NeSySpec 是一个基于逻辑张量网络的可解释神经-符号审计框架，能在单一流水线中审计工程规格、诊断被违反的物理约束、通过溯因推理识别被篡改字段并给出最小变更修正方案，已在107种飞机型号上完成验证。
en_tdlr: NeSySpec is an interpretable neuro-symbolic audit framework built on Logic Tensor Networks that audits engineering specifications in a single pipeline—diagnosing violated physical constraints, identifying altered fields via abduction, and proposing minimum-change corrections—validated on 107 aircraft types.
